notice.title: Photosensitivity notice
notice.body: Cosmic Drift has bright effects, camera shake, and fast movement. Some people can have seizures or discomfort from flashing lights. If that includes you, or you feel unwell while playing, stop and talk to a doctor.
notice.detail: Nothing in the game flashes more than three times per second. Screen flashes start at Reduced, and animations follow your device's reduced-motion setting.
pause.title: Paused
pause.hint: Esc, P, or Start to resume

pause.quitCarrying.one: You are carrying {count} unbanked shard. Quitting loses it and this level's progress.
pause.quitCarrying.other: You are carrying {count} unbanked shards. Quitting loses them and this level's progress.

settings.title: Settings
settings.saved: Changes are saved on this device.
settings.notSaved: This browser blocks storage: changes last until you close the game.
settings.nextStart: Applies at the next level start or restart.
settings.nextRestart: Takes effect when the level restarts.
settings.audio.musicHint: Music tracks arrive with the planets; the level is set now.
settings.audio.voiceHint: Voice blips arrive with dialogue (2E); the level is set now.
settings.audio.dynamicRangeHint: Night compresses loud and quiet sounds closer together.
settings.graphics.renderScaleHintFollow: Follows the preset. Takes effect with the render-scale work (6A).
settings.graphics.renderScaleHint: Takes effect with the render-scale work (6A).
settings.graphics.postEffectsHint: Bloom, heat haze, and frost arrive with the planets that use them.
settings.graphics.planetHint: Current planet arrives with the hub (2D); until then it is animated.
settings.controls.layoutPresetHint: Simple and Left-handed arrive with the layout editor (2B-4).
settings.controls.editLayoutLater: The layout editor arrives in step 2B-4.
settings.controls.curveHint: 1.0 is linear; higher values give finer control near the centre.
settings.controls.aimDefaultHint: Default: Auto on touch, Manual with a mouse.
settings.controls.aimAssistedHint: Assisted aim arrives with the combat pass (3A); until then it aims like Manual.
settings.controls.shootHint: Toggle: press once to start firing, again to stop.
settings.controls.hapticsHint: Vibration arrives with the Android app's haptics (7B).
settings.gameplay.driftHint: Drift+ unlocks after the campaign; until then it plays as Hard.
settings.gameplay.flashesHint: Nothing ever flashes more than three times per second.
settings.gameplay.tutorialHint: Hints arrive with the tutorial level (2F).
settings.access.captionsHint: Short captions for important sounds, with an arrow when the sound is off screen.
settings.access.highContrastHint: Opaque HUD and menu panels with bright outlines.
settings.access.colorblindHint: Changes the accent, danger, shard, and core colors. In the level, effects change at the next start or restart. Shapes stay the main signal.
settings.access.reduceMotionHint: Menus change at once; the level follows at its next start.
settings.language.hint: More languages later. The device language is used when it is supported.
settings.data.privacyHint: Relay only hides your IP address from other players and may add latency. Multiplayer arrives in Pass 4.
settings.data.diagnosticsHint: Nothing is sent today; this choice is kept for when crash reports exist.
settings.about.credits: Made with Phaser, Preact, Vite, and Capacitor. Fonts: Exo 2 and Inter (SIL Open Font License). Sounds: Kenney (CC0). Full credits and licenses ship in docs/CREDITS.md.
settings.about.privacy: Privacy: the game stores its settings on this device only and sends nothing anywhere.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.levelMessage: The level stopped because of an error. Restart it to keep playing; nothing else was affected.
safe.title: Safe Mode
safe.message: The game did not start correctly twice in a row, so it is running in Safe Mode: lighter graphics and no sound.
webgl.title: Graphics are not available
webgl.body: Cosmic Drift needs WebGL graphics, which this browser or device has turned off or does not support.
webgl.tipUpdate: Update your browser. On Android, also update "Android System WebView" in the Play Store.
webgl.tipAcceleration: On a computer, turn on hardware acceleration in your browser settings.
webgl.tipBrowsers: Try Chrome, Edge, Firefox, or Safari.
